notes:
Overview:
- SaaS KB provider for mid-to-enterprise SaaS vendors. Multi-tenant product that customer embeds into their admin consoles.
- Looking for hosted API to avoid infra ops; high QPS expected (peak 500-2k qps) with mostly short retrieval flows.
Scale / architecture:
- Target indexing scope: 2–5M short documents (KB snippets + changelogs). Expect daily delta imports ~50–150k docs.
- Retrieval pipeline: ANN vector candidate set (top 100) -> lightweight lexical filter -> neural reranker (top-5 re-rank). Want to push rerank to hosted Redwood runtime.
Performance & cost goals:
- Latency SLOs: 95p end-to-end <200ms (target 120–150ms), first-pass ANN recall step <40ms.
- Cost sensitivity: aim for <= $0.0015 per query averaged across traffic (incl. embeddings + rerank).
Model preferences / routing:
- Prefer embedding models comparable to ada/multi-embedding; reranker to be a smaller instruction-tuned model (cost/latency tradeoff).
- Want routing/fallback: cheaper quantized reranker for low-priority tenants and higher-quality model for premium accounts.
Security & compliance:
- Must support SSO (SAML/OKTA), audit logs for query metadata, and EU data residency for several customers.
POC status & quotes from calls:
- 2024-10-20: "If we can't hit 700 QPS with 150ms p95 we're not moving to hosted." - VP Eng.
- 2024-11-07: SE deep-dive on reranker latency; requested kernel-level perf metrics and KV cache behavior.
Concise nexts / risks:
- Need SOC2 docs + residency plan before procurement signoff.
- Watchout: cost model assumptions; heavy rerank usage could push ARR higher than expected.
